title: Welcome to Burst Browser
text: The Burst Browser allows you to inspect, filter, and gate single-molecule bursts across all measurement runs.

title: Data Source & Columns
text: Select your burst data table and configure observable columns for inspection.

title: Interactive Gating
text: Set gate boundaries on burst size, duration, and FRET parameters to filter your sub-populations.

title: Burst Table & Histograms
text: Inspect the individual burst records in the table and live-updating histogram distributions.
